runtime_prompt_en:
Create a photorealistic beach fashion editorial featuring a clearly adult woman in her mid-twenties wearing a bikini in deep cobalt, guided by the reference portrait's long dark wavy hair and refined facial features. She stands barefoot at the sunlit waterline with her back toward the camera; her body remains a clear back view, with only a slight over-shoulder glance. Compose a vertical full-length portrait from a tasteful low camera angle behind her. Her legs remain softly adducted with the knees close; the actual upper inner thighs form both clean boundaries around a narrow background opening, producing a visible thigh gap. That attractive negative space becomes a deliberate focal geometry; the opening is true anatomy, not a wide stance or a dark shadow. A thigh-dominant full-length crop keeps the geometry legible at thumbnail scale. Warm late-afternoon sunlight rims her hair and shoulders, and fine sea spray catches the light around her calves while gentle waves, pale sand, and a bright horizon complete the serene, high-end editorial scene. Preserve realistic skin texture, natural proportions, and a confident relaxed presence.

Avoid: 3D render look, excessive HDR, broken facial features, cartoon style, illustration look, over-processed retouching, body distortion, low resolution
